title: USAi Model Catalog
description: Harness-neutral catalog of USAi gateway models. Generated from live feeds by build-catalog.mjs; consumed by per-harness emitters. Do not hand-edit the generated catalog.json.

schemaVersion.description: Schema identifier and version for this catalog document.

generatedBy.description: Path/marker signaling this document is derived. Do not hand-edit.

sources.description: Provenance: free-form record of where fields were derived from (e.g. modelsList, enrichment, bootstrappedFrom).

baseUrl.description: Full base URL for the OpenAI-compatible completions API.

api.description: API surface. USAi speaks the OpenAI completions protocol.

apiKeyEnv.description: NAME of the environment variable holding the API key. Never a secret value.

defaults.description: Recommended default models for standard agent roles. Every value must reference a valid model id in models[].

primary.description: Primary interactive coding and instruction-following model.

small.description: Fast, lower-cost model for lightweight sub-tasks and completions.

compaction.description: Cost-effective model for context compaction and conversation summarization.

summary.description: Model that writes a short recap of a finished exchange.

title.description: Model that names a session in one line.

reasoning.description: High-capacity reasoning and architectural planning model.

vendors.description: Model vendors (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, ...), for grouping and display order.

key.description: Stable vendor key referenced by models[].vendor.

order.description: Display/sort order for the vendor group.

usaiBackend.description: USAi backend identifier for this vendor.

models.description: Model definitions available through the USAi gateway.

id.description: Model identifier as used by the gateway (e.g. claude_4_8_opus). Control characters are not allowed; punctuation remains valid neutral catalog data and is serialized by each emitter.

name.description: Human-readable display name. Control characters are not allowed; punctuation and Unicode display text remain valid. Emitters serialize this value independently.

contextWindow.description: Maximum input context window in tokens (opencode limit.context).

maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum output tokens per response (opencode limit.output).

costAbove200kContext.description: Tiered pricing applied above 200k context (opencode cost.context_over_200k).

reasoning.description: Whether the model supports reasoning/extended thinking. Not populated yet.

inputModalities.description: Supported input modalities (e.g. text, image). Not populated yet.
